description.zh-CN: 柠檬IPTV维护的咪咕合并源：央视、卫视与地方台约百个频道，自带回看模板与节目单地址。
description.en: The Migu list LemonTV maintains: about a hundred CCTV, provincial and local channels, with its own replay template and guide.

description.zh-CN: ioptu/migu_video 维护的咪咕视频频道列表；频道地址带时效签名，过期前会自动刷新。
description.en: The Migu Video channel list ioptu/migu_video maintains; its addresses are signed and refreshed before they expire.

description.zh-CN: iptv-org 开源目录的中国频道集（约 150 个，以央视和少数省级为主），地址无签名依赖；来源公开、更新自动，但清晰度与可用性参差。
description.en: iptv-org's China collection (about 150 channels, mostly CCTV and a few provincial), unsigned public addresses; automatically updated, but quality and availability vary.
